mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PROXY-FEEDER build -- PROXY_ASCENSION (the summoner archetype where a proxy does the killing) + PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY (a single dominant super-proxy, the Agony Crawler, whose power scales with the feed). shadow (chaos) family + poison (crosswalk s1: chaos-poison -> shadow, ailment poison; s2 stack-additive native). TWO skill-entries: the crawler proxy (totem, the offense) + the player's Cyclone feeder (whirlwind, pure virulence-generation). THE IDENTITY = 'your hits do nothing but feed Virulence stacks to a scorpion pet that does everything, and the pet dies without the feed'. Virulence -> charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator (build via poison-applications, decays, crawler-power scales off the count, 0=death). The Golden Rule (self-poison feeds virulence too) is an economy accelerant. PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY captures the single-super-minion-fed-by-player-actions structure; the 'proxy DIES if the stack empties' dependency is a behavioral property of the accumulator noted in economy.
